title: Show HN: GitPushups, block your code if you don't do pushups during your workday

item.text:
Hi HN!

I made this tool for a hackathon last year and since then me and other developers have done ~40K pushups during our workday.

I've made all the features free (originally was freemium to compete in RevenueCat's Shipaton 2025) and also added an apple watch app.

More on those changes in the first "monthly press" update: https://gitpushups.com/monthly-press/october-2026

What do you think?
